General Orders

Dropfleet Rulebook 2.4 · 7.1 Group’s Orders

7.1.1 General Quarters

Remove two Spikes from the Group at the beginning of its activation.

The Group may turn up to 45 degrees and then must move between half and full Thrust.

Each Ship may attack with up to half of its listed Weapons rounded up (a Ship with three Weapons could fire two of them).

Each Ship may launch Assets at the end of its Group’s activation.

7.1.2 Silent Running

Remove all Spikes from the Group at the beginning of its activation.

The Group may not turn and must move between half and full Thrust.

The Group cannot attack with any Weapons.

Each Ship may launch Assets at the end of its Group’s activation. If it does not, reduce its Signature to 0” until its next activation.

7.1.3 Weapons Free

The Group cannot turn and must move between half and full Thrust.

Each Ship may attack with any number of its Weapon Systems.

Each Ship may then launch Assets, then the Group gains two Spikes at the end of its activation.

7.1.4 Course Change

The Group may turn up to 45 degrees, must move up to half its Thrust, then make an additional turn up to 45 degrees.

Each Ship may only attack with a single Weapon.

The Group may forgo one of its allowed turns (either the first or second) to launch Assets at the end of its activation.

The Group gains a Spike at the end of its activation.

7.1.5 Max Thrust

The Group may not turn and must move between full and twice its Thrust.

The Group cannot attack with any Weapons.

The Group gains two Spikes at the end of its activation and cannot launch Assets.

7.1.6 Damage Control

Each Ship recovers 1 lost Hull Point. Ships of H and C tonnage recover D3 lost Hull Points instead.

The Group may turn up to 45 degrees, then must move up to half its Thrust.

Each Ship may only attack with a single Close Action Weapon.

The Group may not Launch Assets.

At the end of this Group’s activation, it rolls to repair as if it was the Repair step of the End Phase, then attempts to repel boarders. Roll either a Backup save or a roll of a 6+ for each enemy Battalion aboard each Ship in the Group and remove an enemy Battalion from that Ship for each successful dice

Crippling Effects

Dropfleet Rulebook 2.4 · 7.3.6 Roll for Crippling Effects

The first time any damage reduces a Capital Ship to below half of its starting Hull value, it suffers a Crippling Effect. The defending player rolls 2D6 and consults the table below. Apply the specified effect to that Ship. Each Ship is only affected by this roll once, regardless of the number of times it would be reduced below half of its starting Hull Value.

Except for Fire, a Ship may only have one of each type of Crippling Effect at a time (Spikes are not a Crippling Effect). Any duplicate Crippling Effects are ignored.

Repairable Crippling Effects may be repaired during the End Phase.

ResultCrippling Effect
2-3Energy Surge: Gain a Spike.
4-5Structural Damage: Suffer another point of damage.
6Fire: Gain a Fire Token. At the start of the End Phase, before the Repair step, this ship suffers a point of damage for each Fire Token it has. Repairable. This effect is repaired on a roll of a 3+ instead of a 4+.
7Defence Systems Offline: Gain a Defence Systems Offline Token. A Ship with a Defence Systems Offline token reduces its Energy, Kinetic, Backup, and Shield saves by 1, and may be targeted by enemy Ships as if their weapons had the Focused special rule, ignoring Formation Benefits if they do. Repairable.
8Scanners Offline: Gain a Scanners Offline token, reducing this Ship’s Scan to 1”. Repairable.
9Weapons Offline: Gain a Weapons Offline token, preventing this Ship from using Weapons or launching Assets. Repairable.
10Navigation Offline: Gain a Navigation Offline token, reducing this Ship’s total movement to 2” (regardless of Thrust) and preventing it from turning or changing Orbital Layer. Repairable.
11+Orbital Decay: The Ship gains an Orbital Decay token and falls into Atmosphere. Orbital Decay tokens prevent this Ship from moving from Atmosphere into Orbit. Repairable. This effect is repaired on a roll of a 5+ instead of a 4+.

Explosion Table

Dropfleet Rulebook 2.4 · 7.3.7 Roll for Explosion

When a Capital Ship is destroyed by an attack, Crippling effect (including the resulting damage from one), or explosion effect it explodes. The defending player rolls 1D6 and consults the table below. Apply the result to the Ship. Heavy Ships add 1 to their result. Colossal Ships add 2 to their result.

Medium Ships explode with a range of 3”.

Heavy Ships explode with a range of 6”.

Colossal Ships explode with a range of 9”.

ResultExplosion Effect
1Burn Up: The exploding Ship is removed from play with no further effects.
2Reactor Rupture: All Groups and Space Stations within double the explosion range gain a Spike.
3Shredded: All Groups and Space Stations in explosion range suffer 3 Kinetic hits. Assets are removed on a 5+.
4Fuel Detonation: All Groups and Space Stations in explosion range suffer 3 Energy hits. Assets are removed on a 4+.
5Reactor Overload: All Groups and Space Stations in explosion range suffer 3 Core hits. Assets are removed on a 3+.
6+Foldspace Catastrophe: All Groups and Space Stations in explosion range suffer 4 damage and gain a Spike. Assets are removed on a 2+.

Cities & Space Stations

Dropfleet Rulebook 2.4 · 11. Dropsites

Dropsites are strategic locations that often must be Controlled or destroyed. They are either Space Stations, which exist in Orbit, or Cities, which exist in Atmosphere.

Dropsites cannot be moved or turned. Space Station bases cannot be moved onto, as if they were Ships. Cities have a base the size of their template. Bases of Cities are ignored when moving and are moved over as if they were not there.

Features

Dropfleet Rulebook 2.4 · 11.3 Features

Features are distinct elements of a Dropsite. They provide a Dropsite with rules and are represented by tokens or removable parts of a Space Station miniature. Dropsites can gain Features according to the scenario and they can be removed from Dropsites during the game due to damage.

Core Command Point Abilities

Dropfleet Rulebook 2.4 · 4.2.1.1 Abilities and Ability Points

Players have access to 4 core Abilities that have no restrictions on the number of times they may be used each round:

CostEffect
1APAP Dice Bonus: Once per Group, Asset, or Dropsite activation, or during the Repair step of the End Phase, after you roll any dice, you can add 1 to the result of one of those dice. This Ability cannot be used on D3s or dice results of a 1, and dice modified by this ability cannot score criticals.
1APBrace for Impact: After you roll for Crippling Effects, re-roll the Crippling Effect roll.
2APContain Reactor: When a player would roll for Explosion, instead of rolling, make the result of an Explosion roll (for you or your opponent) a 2.
2APTime to Target: After moving a Wing of your Fighters or Bombers, you may move that Wing (or the Wing it combined into) a second time with a Thrust of 6” in any direction. The Wing cannot divide into smaller Wings or form/be formed into larger Wings due to this additional movement.

PHR Abilities

PHR Combined Fleet Stats

Famous and Faction Admirals may take additional Abilities from the following table when building your lists. Each Famous and Faction Admiral will state the amount of additional Abilities they may take. You can only take each Ability once per list.

CostEffect
2APCountermeasures Hack: At the start of a friendly Group’s activation, choose an enemy Ship in line of sight of a friendly Admiral. Until the end of the activation, that Ship counts as having a Defences Offline token. If this Ability targets a H or C tonnage Group, this Ability costs 3AP.
2APWeapons Hack: When an opponent assigns weapons to friendly Ships, choose one of the attacking Group’s Weapon Systems. Until the end of the attacking Ships’ activation, that Weapon System automatically misses on rolls of a 2 or less and your opponent cannot use abilities on those weapons. This can cause that opponent’s unresolved abilities on that Weapon System to be negated.
1APShip Of The Line: When you assign targets to a Group’s weapons, that Group’s Broadside Arc weapons that have the Fusillade-X special rule gain the benefit of their Fusillade rule regardless of the Group’s Order for its attacks this activation. If the attacking Group is on the Weapons Free order, improve the lock of Broadside Arc weapons with Fusillade-X by 1 for this attack sequence.
2APDrive Hack: Once per round, at the start of an enemy Group’s activation, if that Group is in a friendly Admiral’s line of sight, the enemy Group makes a single Backup save. If it fails its (or has no) Backup save, that Group reduces its Thrust value by half this activation.
1APRepair Drone Squadron: At the end of the Repair step of the End Phase, target a friendly Ship. That Ship recovers D3 lost Hull Points.
2APHull Tanking: After an opponent assigns weapons to friendly targets, choose one of those friendly Groups. That Group gains Reinforced Armour until the end of the Activation. If the friendly Group is H or C tonnage, this Ability costs 3AP.
